title: Senior Software Developer -Java Backend Developer
description:
Job Title: Senior Software Engineer – Java Backend Developer  

Position: Java Backend Developer  

Experience: 6 to 8 Years  

Category: Software Development/ Engineering

**Your future duties and responsibilities**


Core expertise includes Java, Spring, Hibernate, and RESTful web services for backend application development.  

Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure smooth backend integration and timely delivery through CI/CD pipelines. Containerize and deploy backend services using Docker and OpenShift Container Platform.  

Follow DevOps best practices for continuous integration, automated testing, and deployment of backend services. Manage source code and versioning using Git.  

Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize backend application performance. Contribute to technical design and architecture discussions, ensuring adherence to backend development best practices.  

  

Key Responsibilities  

Develop and maintain backend business logic using Java frameworks such as Spring Boot and Hibernate. Additional responsibilities include designing and integrating RESTful APIs, database design and management, performance optimization, bug fixing, and collaborating with cross\-functional teams to ensure timely and high\-quality deliveries.

**Required qualifications to be successful in this role**

* Hands\-on experience in Java backend development
* Strong proficiency in Java (Java 8 and above)
* Extensive experience with Spring Boot and Spring Framework
* Solid understanding of Microservices architecture
* Hands\-on experience developing RESTful APIs
* Experience with ORM frameworks like Hibernate / JPA
* Strong understanding of OOP concepts, design patterns, and SOLID principles
* Experience with SQL / NoSQL databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, etc.)
* Familiarity with version control systems like Git
* Good understanding of exception handling, logging, and performance tuning

title: Senior SW Engineer (JAVA)
description:
Overview:

JAGGAER provides an intelligent Source\-to\-Pay and Supplier Collaboration Platform that empowers organizations to manage and automate complex processes while enabling a highly resilient, responsible, and integrated supplier base. With 30 years of expertise, we specialize in solving complex procurement and supply chain challenges across various industries.  

Our 1,200\+ global employees are obsessed with ensuring customers get full value from our products—ultimately enhancing and transforming their businesses.  

For more information, visit www.jaggaer.com **Job Title:** Senior Software Engineer  

**Experience Level**: 5\-8 years of professional experience in the applicable field.  

**Education**: Requires a bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. **Job Summary:**  

The Senior Software Engineer is a fully competent professional responsible for delivering complex software solutions by applying broad and deep knowledge of engineering principles, practices, and procedures. This role involves significant technical ownership, with assignments that demand originality, ingenuity, and the ability to make independent decisions that influence the organization’s projects or clients. The Senior Software Engineer cooperates with Architects to identify reference patterns and best practices and mentors and guides junior or intermediate engineers, providing technical direction and oversight when needed.  

The candidate, being in contact with other engineering teams in Europe, India and US, will work to the creation of a microservices architecture built in Java, Spring, React deployed in a container\-based environment (Kubernetes) into a cloud infrastructure
Principal Responsibilities:
* Design, develop, test, and implement complex software systems and applications, ensuring high\-quality, scalable, and maintainable solutions.
* Apply broad technical expertise to solve advanced problems and deliver innovative solutions.
* Lead technical discussions, code reviews, and architectural planning sessions.
* Mentor and provide technical guidance to Associate, Junior, and Intermediate Software Engineers.
* Collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams (e.g., product managers, QA, DevOps) to define and implement requirements.
* Take ownership of projects, ensuring completion within scope, timeline, and quality standards.
* Identify areas for process improvement and recommend enhancements that may have significant business impact.
* Research and evaluate new technologies, tools, or frameworks to improve the development process.
* Act as a subject matter expert (SME) for specific systems, components, or business areas.
* Provide recommendations that influence client deliverables or organizational decisions.


Position Requirements:
* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related discipline (Master’s degree a plus).
* 5\-8 years of professional experience in software engineering or application development.
* Proven experience in Java programming especially with Spring framework (Spring Boot, Spring Security, Spring Data, etc.)
* String experience with API development (REST or GraphQL) and integration projects, with focus on security and performances.
* Proficiency with ORM frameworks and relational databases best practices
* Knowledge of JavaScript frontend frameworks (especially React) is preferred.
* Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and system scalability.
* Experience in cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, or GCP), CI/CD pipelines, and containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
* Familiarity with secure coding practices and performance optimization.
* Experience in leveraging AI coding assistants (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, etc.) and apply prompt engineering to accelerate delivery across development, testing, and operations.
* Able to design and build integrations with LLM services and cloud AI platforms, collaborating with Architects and Product teams to embed AI capabilities and agentic workflows into products.
* Good command of English (written and spoken)

**Skills and Competencies:*** Exceptional problem\-solving and critical\-thinking skills with a high level of technical innovation.
* Strong ability to independently evaluate and make technical decisions with minimal supervision.
* Good communication and leadership skills for collaborating with stakeholders and guiding junior engineers.
* Proactive approach to identifying risks, proposing solutions, and driving technical strategy.
* Ability to manage broad, challenging assignments with originality and ingenuity.

 **Work Environment:*** Operates as a senior\-level individual contributor with minimal lead\-level or middle management intervention.
* Provides oversight and guidance to Associates or Intermediate Engineers.
* Has appreciable latitude for independent action and decision\-making on critical tasks.
* Contributes to strategic technical recommendations that impact business outcomes.

 **What We Offer:**  

At JAGGAER, we are committed to supporting you and your family’s well\-being. Your health is a priority, and we offer a range of programs to help you stay well and thrive. Our benefits include Health, Accidental Insurance, and Term Life. **Our Values \- T.E.A.M:**  

At JAGGAER, our business is about people. Our products are built on intellectual property, but the real differentiator is the teams behind them–the way we collaborate, innovate, solve problems and deliver for customers. TEAM gives us a common set of expectations for how we work together across products, cultures, and geographies.  

* **Transparency** \- Openness Builds Trust: Candor strengthens relationships, speeds decision\-making, and ensures problems are solved together—with customers, teammates, and partners.
* **Entrepreneurial Spirit** – Own It, Drive It, Make It: A scrappy, customer obsessed, problem\-solving mindset is at the cornerstone of both organizational and personal growth
* **Accountability** – Thumbs In, Not Fingers Out: We take responsibility ourselves before pointing elsewhere
* **Metrics\-Driven Results** – Outcomes Over Activities: Data and evidence guide our decisions, help us course\-correct quickly, and ensure we’re delivering real impact.
  

**EEO:**
  

JAGGAER is a proud equal opportunity/affirmative action employer supporting workforce diversity. We do not discriminate based upon race, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, caregiver status, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, genetic information, military, or veteran status, mental or physical disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

title: Engineer, Business Intelligence
description:
**Thank you for considering a career at Ensemble Health Partners India!**

  

Ensemble Health Partners \- The single solution for a frictionless revenue cycle with the purpose of redefining the possible in healthcare by empowering people to be the difference. Our India Office is an extension of Ensemble’s team and culture designed to augment and enhance our talent and skill base in Revenue Cycle Management in addition to our long\-standing presence in technology. Leveraging our platform of services, technology, business intelligence and analytics, our teams are creating and maintaining innovative products and systems to help our revenue cycle operators achieve the most efficient, ideal outcomes for our clients. Our teams are certified in revenue cycle best practices and are supporting end\-to\-end RCM operations. We are at the forefront of innovation using cutting\-edge technology to drive meaningful impact in the Revenue Cycle Management landscape. As a leading player in the industry, we offer an environment that fosters growth, creativity, and collaboration, where your expertise will be valued, and your contributions will make a difference.

 **The Opportunity:**

  

The Business Intelligence Engineer designs, builds, and maintains data solutions that enable accurate reporting, analytics, and operational efficiency within healthcare revenue cycle management. Focuses on developing data pipelines, optimizing data storage, and ensuring data integrity across systems. Applies technical expertise to support business intelligence, automation, and compliance initiatives. Designs and develops data pipelines to extract, transform, and load data from multiple sources into centralized repositories. Optimizes data storage and retrieval processes to improve performance and scalability. Collaborates with analysts, developers, and business stakeholders to ensure data solutions meet functional and operational requirements. Documents data architecture, workflows, and integration processes to maintain clarity and consistency. Tests and validates data solutions to confirm accuracy, reliability, and compliance with organizational standards. Monitors data systems and apply corrective measures to resolve performance or integrity issues promptly. Researches emerging data technologies and recommend enhancements to improve system capabilities and efficiency. **Why Choose Ensemble India?**


People First, Last \+ Always


We believe in putting people at the heart of everything. Our culture is rooted in collaboration, growth and innovation—where your contributions are valued, your voice is heard and your potential is nurtured.

 **A Place to Thrive**


Whether you're just starting out or looking to grow your career, Ensemble India is a place where you can do your best work and be your best self. We offer structured career paths, paid professional certifications, tuition reimbursement and mentorship opportunities to help you advance.

 **Comprehensive Total Rewards**


We support the physical, emotional and financial well\-being of you and your family. Our Total Rewards package include:

* Healthcare coverage for associates and their immediate families including parents
* Paid time off plans
* Retirement benefits
* Recognition and wellness programs
* Market competitive pay rates

 **Inclusive Culture**


Our organization is deeply committed to fostering a positive environment and culture where we celebrate and reward merit and contribution and where every associate feels valued, included, and empowered to succeed.

 **Purpose\-Driven Impact**


We proudly partner with local communities through philanthropic initiatives—from school supply drives to health awareness campaigns—because giving back is part of who we are.

  

Ensemble Health Partners is an **equal employment opportunity employer**. It is our policy not to discriminate against any applicant or employee based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, religion, national origin, age, disability, military or veteran status, genetic information or any other basis protected by applicable **federal, state, or local laws.** Ensemble Health Partners also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these **protected categories.**
